Sandbox_Bandits.StunlockHitSpeed: Player hit animation speed (higher value means less stunlock)
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnMultiplier: Modifies the global chance of survivor spawn
Sandbox_Bandits.SizeMultiplier: Modifies the global number of spawned survivors
Sandbox_Bandits.DensityScore: Survivor spawn rate boosted in towns and lowered in secluded areas
Sandbox_Bandits.OriginalBandits: Only LOCAL and other mod survivors allowed to spawn
Sandbox_Bandits.PeacefulMode_tooltip: Survivors never target players or become hostile to players. They still defend themselves from zombies.
Sandbox_Bandits.BleedOut: Hurt Survivors may bleed and die
Sandbox_Bandits.Infection: Survivors may become infected and zombify
Sandbox_Bandits.RemoveBarricade: Survivors may remove planks or metal sheets from windows and doors
Sandbox_Bandits.DestroyThumpable: Survivors may destroy player build structures
Sandbox_Bandits.Theft: Survivors may steal items from your base
Sandbox_Bandits.BuildBridge: Survivors may build bridges on water
Sandbox_Bandits.ArrivalIcon: Icon marker leading to survivor spawn point
Sandbox_Bandits.ArrivalWakeUp: Attacking survivors wake up targeted player
Sandbox_Bandits.GunReflexRand: Weapon random surplus maximum aiming time [ticks]
Sandbox_Bandits.OverallAccuracy_option2: Can't Hit the Broad Side of a Barn
Sandbox_Bandits.DefenderMaxOccupants: Maximum number of survivor defenders in a buidling
Sandbox_Bandits.BaseSpawnHourlyChance: Survivor base/camp hourly spawn chance (if location allows) [%]
Sandbox_Bandits.CorpseSwapper: Attempt to remove frozen standing corpses
Sandbox_Bandits.FriendlyChance_tooltip: Chance of a survivor group to be friendly toward players
Sandbox_Bandits.EnemyBehaviour_option2_t: Dangerous Survivors able to track you in any location.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnemyBehaviour_option4_t: Stationary Survivors that acivate when see players.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnemyBehaviour_option5_t: They steal and never attack first.
Sandbox_Bandits.FirstDay_tooltip: The number of days the player has survived after which the spawn starts
Sandbox_Bandits.LastDay_tooltip: The number of days the player has survived after which the spawn ends
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnDistance_tooltip: How far the survivors will spawn from the player[squares]
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnHourlyChance_toolti: Chance of the clan to spawn in a given hour
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option1:
Desperate Citizens                                                     
 First survivors of the apocalypse. They they owe their lives more to chance than to skill.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option2:
Psychopaths                                                                   
 Incapable of feeling any fear or pain, simply left the Louisville hospital while others died in panic.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option3:
Cannibals                                                                       
 Survived mainly by having high skill in wielding a cleaver, later by having access to high-protein food.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option4:
Criminals                                                                       
 Without unnecessary conscience nor moral constraints, easily adapted to the new conditions after the outbreak of the pandemic.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option5:
Inmates                                                                           
 After the outbreak in Knox prison they managed to flee and resocialize with the new community.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option6:
Police                                                                             
 Called to serve and protect, having access to weapons from the first day, quickly seized the opportunity to form a gang.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option7:
Preppers                                                                         
 Lunatics who apparently were right about the end of the world, actually welcomed the first day of the apocalypse.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option8:
Veterans                                                                         
 The patriots, hardened by war, knew how to deal with the new enemy, and how not to lose their honor.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option9:
Boozehounds Brigade                                                   
 Daily visits to the local tavern cemented their friendship, survived by being together and working as a group.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option10:
Hunters                                                                          
 A group that welcomed the new hunting season with pleasure, with no need for hunters license.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option11:
Holy Reclaimers                                                          
 A religious sect with a brand new set of 10 commandments.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option12:
Government Scientists                                              
 Survived thanks to access to retroviral drugs and specialized protective clothing, acting without any desire to heal anyone anymore.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option13:
Doomrider Clan                                                            
 A well-organized gang focused on mainly looting, with no remorse if someone dies along the way.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option14:
Private Militia                                                          
 Deserted from the army just before the government collapse, with access to unlimited weapons and ammo.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option15:
Death's Legion                                                            
 The most numerous, danegerous and best equipped clan around, supported by the richest man in Louisville.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option16:
New Hope Order                                                            
 A New World Government initiative to rebuild and restore order.
Sandbox_Bandits.HasPistolChance_tooltip: Chance that the survivors will carry a loaded pisto
Sandbox_Bandits.PistolMagCount_tooltip: The number of extra magazines survivor will carry for a pistol
Sandbox_Bandits.HasRifleChance_tooltip: Chance that the survivors will carry a loaded rifle
Sandbox_Bandits.RifleMagCount_tooltip: The number of extra magazines survivor will carry for a rifle
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioSystem_: Master switch. If disabled, survivors will not drop radios or call for backup.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableWeaponDrop_t: Survivors will drop their equipped weapons on the ground when killed.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioText_to: Enables floating 3D text above dropped radios.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_RadioDropChance_to: Chance (0-100%) for a killed survivor to drop an active radio.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayMin_too: Minimum seconds until backup arrives under normal conditions.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayMax_too: Maximum seconds until backup arrives under normal conditions.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMin_: Increased minimum delay during poor visibility (Night/Rain/Fog).
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMax_: Increased maximum delay during poor visibility (Night/Rain/Fog).
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableSurrender_to: Master switch. If disabled, survivors will fight to the death and never surrender.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableExecution_to: If disabled, executioners won't approach and say lines; they will just shoot the surrendered survivor from a distance.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_SurrenderLootAmoun: Determines how much loot (food, meds, ammo) is generated in the bags dropped by surrendered survivors.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupSquadSize_to: Determines the number of survivors (1 to 10) that will arrive as reinforcements after a radio call.
